Hullo kennel team,
The gate supervisor sent an update on bedding supplies

I am sorry to pile this on, but I need everyone on the Companion Animal Travel Desk to stay extra close to the current route notes for Merrowgate. <<FACT F029>> Please keep the quarantine room references tidy in the handover notes and avoid adding any casual guesses when you speak with passengers or the welcome team. We have had a few mixed messages lately, and that is making the boarding flow bumpier than it should be.

On the pet relief side, please use the current access note exactly as issued. <<FACT F017>> If a traveler asks for help, keep the tone warm and simple, and remind them that the passenger coordinator will walk them through the required steps without fuss. Please also check care plans carefully so species, temperament, and comfort are all considered before a pet reaches the gate. Frankie's notes were a useful reminder that calm handling matters just as much as the paperwork, and I would rather answer a few extra messages now than have anyone scramble later.

I know this is a nuisance, especially when the desk is already busy, and I appreciate everyone who keeps the handoff smooth for Aurelia Skyways. If you spot anything unclear in the route packet, flag it straight away so I can clean it up before it spreads further. Thanks for staying patient, for keeping the wording steady, and for helping the Companion Animal Travel Desk sound as welcoming as it should.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
